answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 161650 Country: India Title: Can I cut hairs, moustache, nails after doing wudhu and then perform salah with same wudhu? Question: Can I cut hairs, moustache, nails after doing wudhu and then perform salah with same wudhu? Answer ID: 161650 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1211/1020/L=9/1439) There is no harm in shaving head hair, trimming moustache or cutting nails after wudhu. If someone did wudhu and thereafter shaved the head hair or moustache or cut his nail then fresh wudhu is not necessary for him. "ولا يعاد الوضوء بل ولا بل المحل بحلق رأسه ولحيته كما لا يعاد الغسل للمحل ولا الوضوء بحلق شاربه وحاجبه وقلم ظفره". (در مختار: 1/216، المحيط البرهاني: 1/216) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
